sharedDecision: FL-23; no independent duplicate standing ruling

authoredScenarios.question: SO-01
authoredScenarios.premise: An authorized clerk already agrees to show an available ledger.
authoredScenarios.expectedUnderUnadoptedProposal: No check is required; record any actual viewing time and conditions. A roll does not create an extra benefit.

authoredScenarios.question: SO-01
authoredScenarios.premise: A natural 20 is proposed for asking a clerk to transfer property they cannot authorize.
authoredScenarios.expectedUnderUnadoptedProposal: Identify the missing authority before rolling; no total grants the transfer. A changed request can be considered separately.

authoredScenarios.question: SO-02
authoredScenarios.premise: Fixed DC12, modifier+4, natural8; no additional critical benefits declared.
authoredScenarios.expectedUnderUnadoptedProposal: Total12 is Success and obtains exactly the promised success on stated terms. The Director cannot add an unannounced price by reserving success for22.

authoredScenarios.question: SO-02
authoredScenarios.premise: Fixed DC12, modifier+4, natural7, declared alternative costs5gp; compare opposed14 versus14.
authoredScenarios.expectedUnderUnadoptedProposal: The fixed task fails at11. The player may accept the recorded5gp alternative or keep the money and refusal. The distinct opposed tie leaves the existing state unchanged; do not convert natural task shifts into tie modifiers.

authoredScenarios.question: SO-03
authoredScenarios.premise: An Insight approach has observable hesitation but no access to the hidden document being discussed.
authoredScenarios.expectedUnderUnadoptedProposal: Resolve only the declared obtainable inference. Success does not read the document or reveal cosmic alignment; failure does not force belief in a fabricated fact.

authoredScenarios.question: SO-03
authoredScenarios.premise: A character succeeds at entertaining a crowd with Performance and asks for an automatic license and a second free Persuasion roll.
authoredScenarios.expectedUnderUnadoptedProposal: Honor the declared audience response. The other requested outcomes need actual authority and distinct unresolved approaches; Performance does not grant them.

authoredScenarios.question: SO-04
authoredScenarios.premise: A known companion-schema score+2 and a legacy Loop-schema score+2 appear on separate imported characters.
authoredScenarios.expectedUnderUnadoptedProposal: Preserve both originals and their formats. Only the known companion integer carries forward automatically; the Loop number needs a recorded interpretation because its meaning differs.

authoredScenarios.question: SO-04
authoredScenarios.premise: A new Medic background has been applied once; earned standing, an unknown faction key, explicit zero and a malformed source value now exist.
authoredScenarios.expectedUnderUnadoptedProposal: Reapplying the background cannot reset earned scores. Keep unknown keys, explicit zero and the unresolved malformed value. Do not normalize them away or claim absence equals recorded zero.

authoredScenarios.question: SO-05
authoredScenarios.premise: The preserved Player alignment paragraph is encountered during the ordinary social conference.
authoredScenarios.expectedUnderUnadoptedProposal: Retain the whole original as a deferred receipt. The proposal recommends no automatic alignment modifier pending review, but grants no authority to adopt that boundary or interpret cosmology before GPT's explicit disposition.

authoredScenarios.question: SO-05
authoredScenarios.premise: Two characters openly share a stated civic objective but their cosmic alignment is unknown.
authoredScenarios.expectedUnderUnadoptedProposal: Their communicated objective can supply ordinary scene leverage; it does not establish identical cosmic alignment or grant the legacy automatic advantage.

authoredScenarios.question: SO-06
authoredScenarios.premise: Three participants and an interpreter complete a declared ten-minute exchange concurrently.
authoredScenarios.expectedUnderUnadoptedProposal: Advance the shared clock by ten minutes, plus only actual separately required time. Do not charge forty minutes or count translation as an unrelated spell component.

authoredScenarios.question: SO-06
authoredScenarios.premise: A character tries to finish a minute-long bargain during one six-second combat round with a blocked communication channel.
authoredScenarios.expectedUnderUnadoptedProposal: The bargain does not complete for free and the channel must actually work. Preserve initiative costs, effect deadlines and threats; a social skill cannot erase the missing channel.

authoredScenarios.question: SO-07
authoredScenarios.premise: A helper in initiative spends Help; the ally waits until after the helper's next regular start to check.
authoredScenarios.expectedUnderUnadoptedProposal: The existing Help benefit has expired. Social rules do not extend its reviewed deadline.

authoredScenarios.question: SO-07
authoredScenarios.premise: After refusal, four allies repeat the same approach; later one supplies a genuine authorization letter.
authoredScenarios.expectedUnderUnadoptedProposal: Speaker rotation alone grants no new resolutions. The new letter may establish a new approach with fresh disclosed stakes and time; earlier costs and refusal remain recorded.

authoredScenarios.question: SO-08
authoredScenarios.premise: A target is Charmed by the speaker, who requests a concession outside the target's authority.
authoredScenarios.expectedUnderUnadoptedProposal: Preserve the charmer's social advantage where a legal check exists. Charmed supplies neither authority nor obedience, so it cannot make this concession possible.

authoredScenarios.question: SO-08
authoredScenarios.premise: Ordinary Intimidation succeeds; a separate actual Frightened source is no longer visible.
authoredScenarios.expectedUnderUnadoptedProposal: Intimidation does not itself apply Frightened. Under the actual condition, loss of source visibility ends only its visibility-dependent disadvantage; the willing-approach restriction follows the source's existing duration.

authoredScenarios.question: SO-09
authoredScenarios.premise: An NPC accepts a bargain about property belonging to an absent owner they do not represent.
authoredScenarios.expectedUnderUnadoptedProposal: Their agreement cannot transfer the absent owner's property. The speaker's success remains limited to the authority stated before the roll.

authoredScenarios.question: SO-09
authoredScenarios.premise: A player invokes a character's social feature to override another player's Session Zero boundary.
authoredScenarios.expectedUnderUnadoptedProposal: The feature does not provide table agreement. Pause or revise under the existing table contract; do not impose a character penalty for using that procedure.

authoredScenarios.question: SO-10
authoredScenarios.premise: A confirmed major scene event proposes+2 standing from+2 under the recommended−3..+3 policy.
authoredScenarios.expectedUnderUnadoptedProposal: Record original+2, attempted+2, applied+1, resulting+3 and overflow+1. Replaying the same institution/scene event adds nothing; the overflow is history, not banked future credit.

authoredScenarios.question: SO-10
authoredScenarios.premise: A private rescue changes one NPC's relationship; another institution learns of it through a later report.
authoredScenarios.expectedUnderUnadoptedProposal: Do not grant omniscient global standing. Record the actual information event and the receiving institution's own attributable reaction, keeping report versus established fact distinct.

authoredScenarios.question: SO-11
authoredScenarios.premise: A faction's interview runs10:00–12:00; a return occurs11:00 and the same expedition crosses the threshold again11:05.
authoredScenarios.expectedUnderUnadoptedProposal: The interview remains incomplete at11:00; the repeat crossing is not another return checkpoint and grants no work, tick or substitute completion.

authoredScenarios.question: SO-11
authoredScenarios.premise: A return and a proposed completed24-hour Haven checkpoint coincide while one actor has two incompatible assignments.
authoredScenarios.expectedUnderUnadoptedProposal: The proposal processes one checkpoint, never duplicated hours or actions. The actor cannot complete both assignments with the same interval. The24-hour cadence still requires FL-03/FL-24 joint review.

authoredScenarios.question: SO-12
authoredScenarios.premise: A Claim clock at2/4 receives one new witness event, then two reports of that same event.
authoredScenarios.expectedUnderUnadoptedProposal: Advance once to3/4. Preserve the report records without creating more segments. A distinct later qualifying document can advance the clock again.

authoredScenarios.question: SO-12
authoredScenarios.premise: A Depth clock reaches its threshold before the real route can be traversed; a Grudge clock fills during conversation.
authoredScenarios.expectedUnderUnadoptedProposal: Record the Depth project's missing prerequisite instead of teleporting the rival. Grudge schedules its stated response through a real action, without a free immediate attack. Each objective's consequence resolves at most once.
